title: Spotlite plugin gallery index
description: The list Settings → Plugins → Browse Gallery… reads. Spotlite skips an entry that breaks these rules and shows the rest.

version.description: Format version. Spotlite refuses an index with a version it doesn't know.

id.description: The plugin's id, as in its plugin.json. Unique in the index, ignoring letter case.

version.description: The version the source holds, as in its plugin.json. Compared with the installed version to offer an update.

source.description: Any https address Install → From URL… accepts: a GitHub repository or …/tree/<ref>/<folder>, a .zip, or a .git address.

homepage.description: An https page about the plugin.

icon.description: An SF Symbol name. Images are never downloaded.

tags.description: Lowercase words people may search for. Spotlite shows the first 8.
